name: slot-machine-roll
title: Slot Machine Roll
description: Each character sits on its own vertical reel and springs from the old value to the new one, one column after another, like a casino drum. Values of different lengths are right-aligned.
useWhen: Revealing a price change, plan upgrade or before/after value that includes symbols ($, %, x).
A playful, casino-reel feel on a pricing or comparison slide, with short values (1 to 6 characters).
avoidWhen: The value is a large plain number like 1,240,000: use rolling-number.
The text is longer than about 6 characters: it gets hard to read while the reels spin; use staggered-fade-up.
The tone is formal or data-driven: use rolling-number for a composed odometer.
author: Remocn

variables.label: From
variables.description: Starting value shown before the reels roll.

variables.label: To
variables.description: Value the reels settle on. Keep it short (1 to 6 characters).

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels; it also sets the reel travel. Long values shrink to fit the frame.
